description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Mohomed Samun Mohomed Safwan as a member of Pannala P/S and Mr. Meera Sahibu Mohomed Nasir as a Member of the Eravur Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha and Eravur Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of elected members to fill vacancies caused by death and appointment to another council. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and declarations of elected members to local authorities.
